title: Lease expired
description: What the instance did when an agent's lease expired (sections 5.3 and 5.8): one event per agent, with that agent as subject.

lease_ttl_ms.description: The lease's TTL as the instance applied it (section 5.3): one under 10 seconds as it is, never lengthened, and one above 300 seconds as 300.

cause.description: Why the lease ran out: no renewal arrived, or only stale ones did (section 5.3).

halt_mode.description: The halt mode that the instance applied (section 5.3).

layers.description: The layers of the halt mode applied, each with its outcome (sections 5.3 and 5.8).
